description.sub_name: 科學化可預測分析實務
description.describe_ch: 秉持力學領域之傳統，導入優化求解器之架構，藉由分析軟體之效能協助高分子材料力學、熱力學與流體力學領域，應用於產業及其先進製程優化與迎戰變化快速的市場需求。本課程藉由講授高分子材料、力學分析與相關模型建置等，利用專業分析軟體提供完善的先進製程模擬，協助使用者在產品創新與開發，並在智慧製造浪潮的推波助瀾之下，投入一套系統化的管理工具，將可協助企業彙整數據、統一管理。
description.describe_eh: Based on the tradition of the field of mechanics, Assisting and applying the fields of polymer material mechanics, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics with the performance of analysis software to the industry and its advanced process optimization and to meet the rapidly changing market needs. By teaching polymer materials, mechanical analysis, model building, and using professional analysis software, this course provides can not only complete advanced process simulations to assist users in product innovation and development but can also contribute to the development of smart manufacturing. This set of systematic management tools will assist companies in data collection and unified management.

targets.describe_ch: 高分子材料、塑性加工製程與產品成型之細部設計與相關規格表介紹。
targets.describe_en: Detailed design and related specification sheets introduction of polymer materials, plastic processing processes and product molding.

targets.describe_ch: 了解材料、流體與熱力學領域及其製程，以及與加工參數設定與機台響應數據的科學意義。
targets.describe_en: Understand the fields of materials, fluids and thermodynamics and their manufacturing processes, as well as the scientific influences on processing parameter settings and machine response data.

targets.describe_ch: 塑性加工與工程力學分析系統，以及如何進行科學化試模。
targets.describe_en: Plastic processing and engineering mechanics analysis system, and how to conduct scientific mold testing.

targets.describe_ch: 科學化產品設計與成型條件之調整，以及機台響應數據資料的取得與判讀。
targets.describe_en: Scientific product design and adjustment of molding conditions, as well as acquisition and interpretation of machine response data.

targets.describe_ch: 依照科學化步驟實驗逐步進行成型條件調整，以及相關條件的修改設定之科學數據建置。
targets.describe_en: Following the scientific steps to gradually adjust the molding conditions and establishing the scientific data for the modification and settings of related conditions.

readings.tpc_book: 科學化可預測分析實務課程教學講義

iSoftwares.soft_memo: Moldex3D-協助學生透過塑膠射出成型專業模擬分析軟體，學習並了解科學理論與實務分析。

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 科學化射出成型之案例分享
統籌科目參與期中集中會考
專題自主分析結果驗收與判讀

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 平時成績40%、 期中測驗30%、 期末成果30%。
